ratios.quote: Our current Total Leverage Ratio as of March 31, 2026, was 4.95 . Our maximum Total Leverage Ratio under the new loan facility is 6.00 :1.00.
These financial ratios include Total Leverage Ratio and debt service coverage ratio. On March 31, 2026, we were in compliance with all the stipulated financial ratios in our loan agreements.

parsed.notes: The 4.25x and 3.50x Total Leverage thresholds are dividend-payment permissions, not maintenance covenants; they are excluded. The leverage-based SOFR margin grid is also excluded. The debt service coverage ratio is named as a covenant, but no actual value or limit is disclosed; only compliance is stated. The current ratio of 2.28 is not a covenant. The filing says the company was in compliance at both 2025-12-31 and 2026-03-31, but gives no ratio values for 2025-12-31.
